prompt:
Tum ek WhatsApp group chat ke liye chhote, natural Hinglish messages likh rahe ho (Roman script).
Group members (sender ke roop mein sirf yehi naam use karo): Mahesh bhai, Mahesh S., Karthik bhai, Abhijit bhai.
Topic: roz ki baatein, paise ka lena-dena, milna-julna. Kabhi kisi record, entry ya transaction ko delete
ya hatane ka zikr mat karo. Koi ank (digit), rakam, tareekh, din ya mahine ka naam, web address,
bank/app/company ka asli naam, aur bhejna/pay/transfer jaise nirdesh bhi mat likho.
Neeche har hisse ke liye utne hi messages do jitne bole gaye hain, time ke order mein:
- between 6:30 pm and 6:45 pm: 4 messages
- between 6:45 pm and 7:21 pm: 8 messages
- between 7:24 pm and 7:41 pm: 3 messages
- between 7:41 pm and 8:30 pm: 13 messages
Sirf ek JSON list do, koi aur text nahi: [{"time": "9:02 pm", "sender": "NAAM", "text": "message"}, ...]
Har "time" "h:mm am" ya "h:mm pm" format mein ho. Har message ek hi line ka ho.
text:
[
  {"time": "6:31 pm", "sender": "Abhijit bhai", "text": "Haan bhai sab log kahan ho abhi?"},
  {"time": "6:34 pm", "sender": "Mahesh bhai", "text": "Main toh abhi dukaan par hi hoon."},
  {"time": "6:39 pm", "sender": "Karthik bhai", "text": "Chai peene aao yaar sab log."},
  {"time": "6:42 pm", "sender": "Mahesh S.", "text": "Haan thodi der mein nikalta hoon wahan se."},
  {"time": "6:47 pm", "sender": "Abhijit bhai", "text": "Waise woh purana hisab dekh lena ek baar."},
  {"time": "6:52 pm", "sender": "Mahesh bhai", "text": "Konsa hisab bhai? Woh saman wala?"},
  {"time": "6:58 pm", "sender": "Abhijit bhai", "text": "Haan wahi jo kal baat hui thi humari."},
  {"time": "7:03 pm", "sender": "Karthik bhai", "text": "Mujhe bhi thoda aage piche lag raha hai usme."},
  {"time": "7:09 pm", "sender": "Mahesh S.", "text": "Chinta mat karo, mil kar baithte hain toh dekh lenge."},
  {"time": "7:14 pm", "sender": "Abhijit bhai", "text": "Sahi baat hai, mil kar hi samajh aayega."},
  {"time": "7:17 pm", "sender": "Mahesh bhai", "text": "Maine sab likh kar rakha hua hai waise."},
  {"time": "7:20 pm", "sender": "Karthik bhai", "text": "Acha hua sab clear karke rakha hai."},
  {"time": "7:26 pm", "sender": "Mahesh S.", "text": "Aaj shaam ko milna pakka hai na?"},
  {"time": "7:32 pm", "sender": "Abhijit bhai", "text": "Haan bilkul, purane tapri par milte hain."},
  {"time": "7:38 pm", "sender": "Karthik bhai", "text": "Main thoda der se aaunga par pahunch jaunga."},
  {"time": "7:43 pm", "sender": "Mahesh bhai", "text": "Chalo thik hai, main bhi nikal raha hoon abhi."},
  {"time": "7:47 pm", "sender": "Mahesh S.", "text": "Samaan ka jo baaki hisab hai woh bhi le aana."},
  {"time": "7:51 pm", "sender": "Mahesh bhai", "text": "Sab diary mein hai, aate waqt le aata hoon."},
  {"time": "7:55 pm", "sender": "Abhijit bhai", "text": "Woh jo cash ka tha, uska kya hua?"},
  {"time": "7:59 pm", "sender": "Karthik bhai", "text": "Uska adjustment ho gaya tha shayad."},
  {"time": "8:04 pm", "sender": "Mahesh S.", "text": "Haan woh toh aapas mein samajh liya tha."},
  {"time": "8:09 pm", "sender": "Abhijit bhai", "text": "Acha badhiya hai fir koi dikkat nahi."},
  {"time": "8:13 pm", "sender": "Karthik bhai", "text": "Main raaste mein hoon, thodi jaam hai."},
  {"time": "8:18 pm", "sender": "Mahesh bhai", "text": "Main pahunch gaya hoon tapri par."},
  {"time": "8:22 pm", "sender": "Mahesh S.", "text": "Main bhi bas turant pahunch raha hoon."},
  {"time": "8:25 pm", "sender": "Abhijit bhai", "text": "Chai order kar do mere liye bhi."},
  {"time": "8:28 pm", "sender": "Mahesh bhai", "text": "Haan kar diya hai sabka."},
  {"time": "8:29 pm", "sender": "Karthik bhai", "text": "Main bhi bas pahunch gaya."}
]
